patch_description:
The previous constructor used a 5x5 grid plus one interstitial circle, ten jittered starts, SLSQP iterations of 600/850, LP radius polishing, and sequential pairwise safety repair. This version retains the useful staggered-grid seed portfolio but adds boundary-adapted hexagonal layer seeds, vectorizes the nonlinear constraint Jacobian, and performs deterministic continuation from the best certified arrangement.

The continuation stages use center jitters of 0.004, 0.009, and 0.014 together with contracted initial LP radii of 0.85, 0.72, and 0.60. This allows contact graphs to change without discarding the strongest first-pass solution. The final repair uses a single global certificate scale rather than repeated pairwise shrinking, preserving more of the LP objective while guaranteeing containment and non-overlap.
